title: Router-on-a-Stick (Inter-VLAN Routing)
description: Configure inter-VLAN routing using a router-on-a-stick topology. Create subinterfaces on the router's trunk-facing port and configure 802.1Q encapsulation so hosts in different VLANs can communicate.
scenario: A switch already has VLANs 10 and 20 configured. The trunk link connects to R1's GigabitEthernet0/0. You must create subinterfaces Gi0/0.10 and Gi0/0.20 with 802.1Q encapsulation to enable inter-VLAN routing between the 192.168.10.0/24 and 192.168.20.0/24 networks.

tasks.description: Configure Gi0/0.10 with 802.1Q encapsulation for VLAN 10

check.description: Gi0/0.10 must have dot1q VLAN 10 encapsulation

tasks.description: Configure Gi0/0.20 with 802.1Q encapsulation for VLAN 20

check.description: Gi0/0.20 must have dot1q VLAN 20 encapsulation
